title: Senior Engineer, Autonomy and Motion Planning (R5263)
description: Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai . Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn , X , Instagram , and YouTube . Job Description: This position on the Autonomy team in the UK will lead the delivery of autonomous behaviors into our products, acting as technical leads, senior individual contributors, and/or as team leads that are also hands-on contributors. We expect candidates to demonstrate unparalleled end-to-end outcome ownership, driving the architecting, design, delivery, support, and evolution of safe and effective mission autonomy software throughout the entire product lifecycle. What you'll do: Develop tactical autonomy software to enable unmanned platforms to perform complex missions across air, land, sea, and space domains with minimal human supervision Implement and test behaviors that enable multi-agent coordination, target engagement, reconnaissance, and survivability in contested scenarios Work throughout the entire of the software development lifecycle, from requirements capture through design, implementation, verification, and validation, utilizing tools and workflows consistent with collaborative high-quality software development Champion a product-line mindset in technology road-mapping and to enable reuse of behaviors across multiple projects and portfolios Utilize your software and systems expertise to architect behaviors as scalable software subsystems, that may interact directly or indirectly with a breadth of system components (e.g., sensor processing, state estimation, peer-to-peer communications, contingency management, actuation, and payload interfacing) Leverage internal product and program-specific engineering teams to rapidly deliver state-of-the-art capabilities to vehicle platforms (whether internally and externally owned), with a clear path towards architecture and capability evolution over time Collaborate with external teams, aligning on interfacing requirements between diverse systems, often working closely with vehicle integration teams and associated operational subject matter experts (e.g., fighter pilots, UAV operators, etc.) Act as a subject matter expert for software engineering, representing software equities in a multi-stakeholder environment including engineering, business and sales leadership. Travel to co-locate with end-users and/or other teams up to 20% of the time Required qualifications: BS/MS/PhD in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field Proficient in production-level C++ software development 7+ years' experience in one or more of the following: software sub-system scheduling and integration, behavior planning, task and resource allocation, motion planning, optimization, or flight controls Experience with collaborative software development tools for version control, issue tracking, code reviews, and release management Proven ability to lead multi-disciplinary teams, set technical direction, and manage full project lifecycles from concept to deployment Capacity to learn and grow individually, while mentoring junior team members effectively, building team cohesion and capacity Desire to work in a highly collaborative, fast paced, enthusiastic, and mission-centric environment Capacity to act as the technical owner for an entire software system, including stakeholder engagement, requirements definition, roadmap management, team co-ordination, design, implementation, sustainment, and evolution Preferred qualifications: Experience across a breadth of technology readiness levels (TRLs) and demonstration of bridging concepts from research-grade to operationally ready Experience with mission systems integration, and ideally, hands-on experience supporting integration events and/or flight demonstrations Experience across a multitude of application areas, including but not limited to: Collaborative mission planning, behavior planning, synchronized teaming Automated red force vs blue force tactics Motion planning across a variety of vehicle classes, kinematic constraints, and team compositions Weapons target assignment, Sensor target pairing, sensor-centric control laws Collision avoidance, geofencing, and safety-monitoring Experience in more than one operational effect (e.g., strike, air combat, surveillance, reconnaissance, etc.) and more than one associated domain (e.g., air, space, maritime, ground, etc.) Experience with FOSS software that is commonly used in robotic systems (e.g., ROS, OMPL, optimization solvers, etc.) Experience with simulation tools and environments (e.g., AFSIM, NGTS) for testing and validation Familiarity with practical aspects of navigation and communications systems Experience across the product delivery lifecycle, from emerging opportunity through system acceptance, deployment, and sustainment Familiarity with systems engineering methodologies Familiarity with high-assurance software development processes (e.g., DO-178C or equivalent MIL-STD's) Why join Shield AI: Help build the defining defence technology company of this century. Work at the forefront of AI, autonomy, and next-generation defence systems. Operate in a highly entrepreneurial and mission-driven environment. Make a direct impact on international growth and strategic defence partnerships. Collaborate with exceptional teams solving some of the world’s most complex operational challenges. #LI-LD2 #LD Our international teammates receive a comprehensive total rewards package aligned to your country office location. title: Management Consulting, Head of AI and Technology
description: <h2>Role purpose</h2> <p>The Head of AI and Technology is accountable for the direction, delivery and adoption of AI across Teneo Management Consulting and for ensuring that its broader technology environment supports the needs of the business. The role sets the AI strategy and investment priorities, leads the AI Engineering team, owns the strategy and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data, knowledge-management workflows and subscriptions, and acts as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT on centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.</p> <p>The role connects Management Consulting's priorities with Teneo's central AI team, Teneo IT and other control and enabling functions. It translates business needs into Management Consulting-owned AI and technology initiatives or clear requirements for central teams, moves high-value AI and software solutions from experimentation into reliable use, and gives consultants the skills and support required to use approved AI tools effectively.</p> <p>It is primarily an internal capability role. The role is accountable for the allocation and utilisation of the AI Engineering team, including support for selected client engagements, and for the Management Consulting-specific AI and broader technology within its remit. Teneo IT and Teneo's central AI team remain accountable for the centrally managed services and capabilities, while Management Consulting engagement leaders retain accountability for client relationships, overall engagement delivery and revenue targets.</p> <h2>Key responsibilities</h2> <h3>AI strategy and priorities</h3> <ul> <li>Own the Management Consulting AI strategy, roadmap and priorities, aligned with the business strategy and Teneo-wide AI direction. Consult Teneo's central AI team on new solutions to reuse firm-wide capabilities, avoid duplication and manage enterprise dependencies.</li> <li>Identify and assess AI opportunities across consulting delivery, business development, proposition development, internal operations and knowledge work.</li> <li>Own prioritisation of AI opportunities and allocation of AI Engineering capacity within the approved budget, considering value, feasibility, risk, reuse potential, capacity and cost. Escalate material investments, major reprioritisation and strategically sensitive work to Management Consulting leadership.</li> <li>Develop business cases and recommend whether Management Consulting should build, buy, partner, reuse a central capability, scale an existing initiative or stop further investment.</li> <li>Define outcome measures for priority AI initiatives and report progress, realised value, adoption, spend, risks and dependencies to Management Consulting and wider Teneo leadership.</li> </ul> <h3>Leadership of the AI Engineering team</h3> <ul> <li>Lead the day-to-day work of the Management Consulting AI Engineering team, including objectives, prioritisation, resource allocation, workforce planning, utilisation, delivery oversight and performance management.</li> <li>Balance the team's capacity across client engagements, internal tooling development, enablement of the broader MC team, and technical capability improvement, while maintaining sustainable workloads.</li> <li>Set and enforce engineering and product standards for Management Consulting AI solutions, consistent with mandatory Teneo-wide architecture, AI, security and technology standards.</li> <li>Define clear demand, resourcing and decision-making processes between the AI Engineering team and key stakeholders, including Resourcing, Operations, Finance, project leads and the wider client-facing team.</li> <li>Build the team's capability through recruitment, coaching, feedback, career development and targeted use of external partners where justified.</li> <li>Maintain high practical AI fluency and sufficient technical understanding to create simple prototypes, automations and demonstrations, evaluate their outputs and translate business needs into clear engineering requirements, without becoming the bottleneck for implementation.</li> </ul> <h3>AI service lifecycle</h3> <ul> <li>Oversee the path from discovery and prototyping to production, adoption, support and retirement for Management Consulting AI solutions.</li> <li>Ensure solutions are designed for reuse where appropriate and integrate with approved data, identity, security and collaboration environments.</li> <li>Establish proportionate evaluation and monitoring for quality, reliability, user experience, cost and risk, including controls for generative AI outputs.</li> <li>Define ownership and support arrangements before launch, and ensure that technical debt, maintenance and business continuity inform investment and prioritisation decisions.</li> </ul> <h3>Business partnership and consulting integration</h3> <ul> <li>Partner with Management Consulting leadership and practice leads to translate business priorities into a focused AI agenda and secure decisions on investment, risk and operating change.</li> <li>Support proposition and methodology development by identifying where approved AI capabilities can improve the quality, speed or differentiation of consulting work.</li> <li>Advise case teams on feasible and responsible use of AI, deploying the AI Engineering team where specialist support is justified. Own the team's allocation and utilisation; engagement leaders remain accountable for client relationships and engagement delivery.</li> <li>Represent Management Consulting in relevant Teneo forums and maintain productive relationships with external technology and delivery partners.</li> </ul> <h3>Teneo IT partnership and centrally managed technology</h3> <ul> <li>Act as the principal Management Consulting stakeholder for Teneo IT, representing the business's needs and priorities in relation to centrally managed technology, data platforms and services.</li> <li>Translate Management Consulting requirements into clear input for firm-wide technology strategy, roadmaps and investment decisions, and communicate central plans, constraints and decisions to Management Consulting leadership.</li> <li>Coordinate with Teneo IT and relevant central functions on architecture, integration, identity and access, hosting, resilience, service support and technology changes affecting Management Consulting.</li> <li>Monitor the performance of centrally managed services within Management Consulting, escalating material issues and working with Teneo IT to agree appropriate action.</li> </ul> <h3>Management Consulting technology, knowledge management and subscriptions</h3> <ul> <li>Own the strategy, roadmap and priorities for Management Consulting-specific technology, software, data and subscriptions, aligned with business and AI priorities and Teneo-wide standards.</li> <li>Maintain a coherent view of Management Consulting applications, data sources, knowledge assets, licences and subscriptions, reducing duplication and addressing material capability gaps.</li> <li>Own selected technology-enabled knowledge-management workflows, including the capture, organisation, permissioning, retrieval and reuse of knowledge for consulting and AI-enabled workflows.</li> <li>Work with client-facing teams and designated knowledge owners to establish clear accountability for the quality, permissions and appropriate use of knowledge assets, while acting as a key stakeholder in wider knowledge-management decisions.</li> <li>Lead business cases, supplier evaluation, procurement and renewals for Management Consulting-specific tools and services. Manage approved expenditure, licences and consumption within delegated authority and the relevant central approval processes.</li> </ul> <h3>Training enablement and adoption</h3> <ul> <li>Set the AI capability-building plan for Management Consulting, based on the needs of different roles, practices and levels of experience.</li> <li>Direct practical training, guidance, demonstrations, office hours and communities of practice that help colleagues apply approved tools to real consulting workflows.</li> <li>Expand the network of leaders and super-users who can reinforce good practice, surface demand and support adoption within their teams.</li> <li>Measure confidence, active use, quality and workflow impact, and adapt the enablement programme where training does not translate into sustained behaviour change.</li> <li>Maintain clear communication on available tools, expected use, limitations, new releases and routes for support.</li> </ul> <h3>Responsible AI governance and risk</h3> <ul> <li>Consult Teneo's central AI team on proposed solutions to identify existing capabilities, avoid duplication and maintain alignment with Teneo-wide AI direction.</li> <li>Work with Cyber Security, Risk, Legal and IT to translate firm-wide requirements into practical delivery and usage controls.</li> <li>Ensure new AI solutions receive the required Cyber Security and Risk approvals prior to implementation, with clear records of decisions, exceptions and accountable owners.</li> <li>Promote safe handling of client and firm information and address emerging model, vendor and regulatory risks as the technology changes.</li> </ul> <h2>Experience and capabilities</h2> <ul> <li>Substantial experience setting and delivering an AI and technology strategy in a professional services, consulting or similarly knowledge-intensive environment.</li> <li>Demonstrable experience leading multidisciplinary technical teams and taking AI or software products from discovery into secure, supported production use, with the judgement to challenge decisions on architecture, integration, evaluation, security and operational support.</li> <li>High practical AI fluency, demonstrated through regular use of generative AI tools and the ability to create and evaluate simple prototypes, automations or workflows. Production coding experience is not required, but the candidate must recognise when specialist engineering support is needed.</li> <li>Evidence of converting ambiguous business needs into prioritised initiatives, investment cases, delivery plans and measurable outcomes.</li> <li>Experience of technology and data governance, including responsible AI, information security, privacy, vendor risk and approval processes.</li> <li>Experience improving data or knowledge-management workflows in a professional services or similarly knowledge-intensive environment, particularly where these support enterprise search, knowledge retrieval or AI-enabled use.</li> <li>Commercial judgement in build-versus-buy decisions, vendor selection, budgets, licences, subscriptions and consumption management.</li> <li>Experience designing enablement or change programmes that produce sustained adoption, rather than training attendance alone.</li> <li>Experience representing a business unit in relation to centrally managed technology services, translating requirements, explaining technical choices clearly and influencing enterprise technology priorities.</li> <li>Strong people leader: sets direction, develops talent, gives clear feedback and builds effectiv

title: EMEA New Business Account Executive
description: <div class="content-intro"><p> </p> <p><strong>About Netcraft</strong></p> <p>Netcraft is the global leader in cybercrime detection and disruption. We’re a trusted partner for three of the four largest companies in the world and many large governments. We've blocked over 225 million cyber-attacks to date, and we take down around 33% of the world's phishing attacks.</p> <p>Our purpose and passion are focused on just one thing: protecting the world from cybercrime.</p> <p>That passion shapes how we work, too. We’re proud of our talented team and the value each person brings, and we’ve built a workplace where people feel supported and inspired. From strong benefits and wellness programs to meaningful collaboration and team connection. </p> <p> </p></div><div id="message-list_1778797102.223239"> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div> <div><strong>The Role </strong><br>Reporting directly to the Director of Sales and working closely with colleagues across the UK and other global teams, this role is wholly focused on winning net new corporate customers across the EMEA region.<br>This is a pure new business role. You will be responsible for identifying, developing, and closing high-value opportunities with net new customers, operating with a high degree of ownership across the full new business sales cycle.<br><br><strong>Why join Netcraft’s commercial team? </strong><br>You will be joining a high-performing commercial organisation with a strong track record of growth and execution. Over recent years, the team has consistently delivered against target, with:</div> <ul> <li>100%+ attainment against ARR targets across multiple years</li> <li>90%+ of fully ramped Account Executives exceeding annual targets in 2025</li> <li>60%+ year-on-year growth in New Sales ARR in 2025</li> <li>Several of the largest new business deals in company history closed in recent quarters</li> </ul> <div><strong>This is what you’ll be doing, day to day: </strong></div> <ul> <li>Driving net new business across the EMEA region and securing contracts with new corporate customers against target</li> <li>Owning the full sales cycle from initial engagement through to close</li> <li>Building and maintaining strong pipeline coverage through a combination of self-generated outbound activity and qualified inbound opportunities</li> <li>Prospecting daily through channels such as email, LinkedIn, phone, and strategic outreach</li> <li>Engaging senior stakeholders to understand business challenges and requirements, particularly in relation to cybersecurity and digital risk</li> <li>Leading commercial conversations and positioning Netcraft’s value clearly in complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles</li> <li>Drafting and delivering compelling proposals, working closely with technical teams where needed to address customer requirements</li> <li>Maintaining accurate pipeline visibility and ensuring Salesforce is updated consistently with high-quality activity and account notes</li> <li>Providing feedback and ideas on ways to shorten sales cycles, improve sales effectiveness, and strengthen Netcraft’s market positioning</li> <li>Conducting all sales activities with a high degree of professionalism, credibility, and integrity</li> </ul> <div><strong>What you’ll need to be successfu</strong>l</div> <ul> <li>Consistent success exceeding quota in complex, long-cycle sales environments</li> <li>A strong track record of measurable achievement, ideally including top-performer recognition such as President’s Club or similar</li> <li>Significant experience in quota-carrying corporate B2B sales roles, with a strong track record of winning net new business and closing high-value deals</li> <li>Proven ability to generate pipeline independently and create opportunities through proactive outbound activity</li> <li>Strong commercial and discovery skills, with the ability to identify customer needs, build urgency, and progress opportunities effectively</li> <li>Experience selling into regulated industries and/or in cybersecurity, digital risk, fraud, SaaS, or similarly complex technical environments would be highly valuable</li> <li>Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage confidently at senior and executive level</li> <li>Strong presentation, negotiation, and influencing skills</li> <li>A high-ownership mindset, with the ability to organise, prioritise, and manage activity effectively, including customer travel where needed</li> <li>Familiarity with Salesforce or a comparable CRM platform</li> <li>A genuine interest in cybersecurity and the ability to build credibility quickly in a technically nuanced market</li> </ul> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p><strong>The Reward Package:</strong></p> <div class="ewa-rteLine"> <ul> <li>33 days annual leave - includes public holidays which can be worked if you prefer</li> <li>Generous enhanced family leave and pay</li> <li>Enhanced company sick pay from day one of employment, with additional support after your first six months’ service</li> <li>Salary sacrifice pension with matched employer contributions up to 5% + NI savings</li> <li>Private health cover, including access to a private GP service</li> <li>Life Assurance at 4 x salary</li> <li>Equity tracking scheme (eligibility criteria apply) - allowing you share in Netcraft's long term success</li> <li>Hybrid and flexible working options</li> <li>Meals, snacks, and drinks provided in the office</li> <li>Comprehensive health, safety, and wellness service available 24/7 for you and your family</li> <li>Two paid Learning & Development days per year plus access to learning resources such as Udemy and Coursera to support your career</li> <li>Two Volunteering Days per year, to allow you to contribute to your wider community or charity</li> <li>Employee Referral Bonus scheme</li> <li>Spot reward bonus scheme to reward truly outstanding contributions </li> </ul> </div><div class="content-conclusion"><p></p> <p><strong>Diversity, Equity & Inclusion </strong></p> <p>This is deeply important to us. Through our ally network, we support under-represented groups and maintain a working environment free from bias, harassment, or discrimination. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. </p> <p>We’re also happy to make adjustments to the hiring process to ensure every candidate can participate fully. </p> <p><strong>Please note:</strong> Netcraft does not accept unsolicited approaches from external recruiters. </p> <p></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description: This isn’t your regular job. Almedia is a place where those who want to push harder can accelerate their careers faster than anywhere else. We’re aiming to become Germany’s second bootstrapped unicorn. Almedia is already Europe’s #3 fastest-growing company in 2025 (FT1000). We are building the future of marketing by rewarding our community of over 95 million users for engaging with our advertisers’ products. We are offering a new way to acquire users for the biggest companies in the world. Staff Machine Learning Engineer London, King's Cross Top-of-market compensation The Role You'll take ownership of designing, building, and shipping production-grade systems that power ranking, personalisation, and reward structures in real time. You work hands-on with a small, high-ownership team. You have real influence over how we build our infrastructure as we grow it together. You spot leverage points others miss: systems that shift behaviour, ranking that balances user value and business sustainability, measurement frameworks that prove what actually works. You own these end to end. What You'll Own Ranking and personalisation systems that reach the right users in real time Reward and payout infrastructure balancing user motivation, cost, and business value Behavioural prediction through time-series and sequence systems Measurement and validation using A/B testing, causal inference, uplift modelling ML infrastructure: pipelines, training loops, serving, monitoring Technical leadership and mentorship on shipping discipline and impact What We're Looking For Shipped production systems end to end, from formulation through impact measurement Full-stack capability: data pipeline to live serving to monitoring and decay Causal thinking: propensity scoring, instrumental variables, contextual bandits, uplift modelling Scale experience: built systems handling high-volume behavioural datasets and real-time inference Published work or equivalent research discipline Builder's mindset: energised by shipping. title: Data Science Manager
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>About us</strong></h3> <p>GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.<br><br>We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific.  For more information, please visit<span><a href="http://www.gocardless.com" target="_blank"> www.gocardless.com</a></span> and follow us on LinkedIn<span><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/gocardless" target="_blank"> ----- is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.</p></div><h3>The role</h3> <p>Data sits at the core of our mission. We leverage bank account data to deliver high-value, intelligent payment solutions for our customers, from enhancing payment success rates to driving payer fraud prevention.</p> <p>As a Data Science Manager within our Payment Intelligence team, you’ll partner with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and Designers to turn big ideas into reality. You’ll own the full lifecycle of our algorithms, shaping everything from the initial concept to production-ready code that powers our global payment network.</p> <p>At GoCardless, our stack is centered around Google Cloud Platform and Vertex AI, providing a high-performance environment for innovation. Our Data Scientists operate at the intersection of Python, SQL, and BigQuery to build and deploy high-performance models at scale.</p> <h3><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Manage and mentor a high-performing team of Data Scientists, fostering a culture of technical excellence and supporting their long-term career development.</li> <li>Oversee the end-to-end lifecycle of mission-critical ML models that power real-time payment decisions.</li> <li>Shape the strategic roadmap for the Payment Intelligence space, translating complex data challenges into actionable, high-impact goals.</li> <li>Drive cross-functional impact by working closely across disciplines to build end-to-end technical solutions, from concept to production.</li> <li>Influence Senior Leadership by acting as the bridge between technical complexity and business value, communicating ML strategy to senior stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites you</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Driving cutting-edge advancements in Data, AI, and Machine Learning within the payments space with a multidisciplinary team.</li> <li>Mentoring a high-performing team and fostering a culture of technical excellence.</li> <li>Solving the complex, real-time challenges of fraud prevention and payment optimisation at scale.</li> <li>Building production-grade ML models on a streamlined GCP and Vertex AI stack to drive fintech innovation.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What excites us</strong></h3> <ul> <li>2+ years managing Data Scientists within complex, high-stakes domains.</li> <li>A hands-on leader comfortable diving into the codebase. You bring strong expertise in Python and SQL to oversee the full lifecycle of a model, from initial prototype to robust production deployment.</li> <li>A decisive collaborator who can navigate technical trade-offs and translate complex ML concepts for cross-functional stakeholders and leadership.</li> <li>Familiarity with complex data environments and model architectures, such as deep learning (experience in Fintech, Fraud Prevention, or Payments is a big plus).<br><br></li> </ul> <p><strong>Base salary range:</strong> £99,200 - £148,800 </p> <p>Base salary ranges are based on role, job level, location, and market data.  Please note that whilst we strive to offer competitive compensation, our approach is to pay between the <span style="text-decoration: underline;">minimum and the mid-point</span> of the pay range until performance can be assessed in role. Offers will take into account level of experience, interview assessment, budgets and parity between you and fellow employees at GoCardless doing similar work.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong>(some of) The good stuff</strong></h3> <ul> <li><strong>Wellbeing </strong>- stay healthy with dedicated support and medical cover</li> <li><strong>Work away scheme</strong> - gives you the option to work away from your country of residence for up to 90 days in any 12 month period</li> <li><strong>Adaptive Working</strong> - allows you to work flexibly, around your lifestyle</li> <li><strong>Parental leave</strong> - to suit everyone embarking on life's great adventure</li> <li><strong>Learning Budget</strong> - lead your own development with an annual learning budget</li> <li><strong>Time off</strong> - generous holiday allowance, + 3 annual volunteer days, + 4 annual business-wide wellness days (‘GC Fridays’)</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Life at GoCardless  </strong></h3> <p>We're an organisation defined by our<span><a href="https://gocardless.com/g/values-operating-principles/" target="_blank"> <u>values</u></a></span>; We <strong><em>start with why</em></strong><em> </em>before we begin any project, to ensure it’s aligned with our mission. We <strong><em>make it happen</em></strong>, working with urgency and taking personal accountability for getting things done. We<strong><em> act with integrity</em></strong>, always. We <strong><em>care deeply</em></strong> about what we do and we know it's essential that we <strong><em>be humble </em></strong>whilst we do it. Our Values form part of the GoCardless DNA, and are used to not only help us nurture and develop our culture, but to deliver impactful work that will help us to achieve our vision. </p> <h3><strong>Diversity & Inclusion</strong></h3> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">As of April 2025, we had 806 employees (GeeCees) globally, with 524 based in the UK, 163 based in Latvia and 119 across our other offices.</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">To ensure that we're representative of the world around us - and to be able to review relevant benchmarks - we ask GeeCees to voluntarily disclose diversity data. This year, the proportion of GeeCees providing data increased to 88% (up from 79% in 2024). With regards to diversity within GoCardless, we can see GeeCees identifying as:</p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Asian, Black, Mixed or Other — <strong>25%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Neurodiverse — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">LGBTQIA+ — <strong>9%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Disabled — <strong>1%</strong> </p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Average age — <strong>33</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Female — <strong>45%</strong></p> <p class="font-claude-response-body break-words whitespace-normal leading-[1.7]">Male — <strong> 55% </strong></p> <p>We’re rooting for you during your application and GoCardless aims to provide reasonable adjustments to make our recruitment process as remarkable and accessible as we can. Please speak to your Talent Partner if you need extra support.</p> <p>If you want to learn more, you can read about our Employee Resource Groups and objectives <u><a href="https://www.google.com/url?q=https://gocardless.com/about/careers/&sa=D&source=calendar&ust=1781014616204220&usg=AOvVaw1DeqgyeRfEwEzecwn4oq3j" target="_blank">here</a></u><br><br><strong>Sustainability</strong><br><br>We’re committed to reducing our impact on the environment, leaving a more sustainable world for future generations. Check out our sustainability <a href="https://gocardless.com/sustainability"><u>action plan</u> </a>here.</p> <p>Find out more about Life at GoCardless via <a href="http://twitter.com/GoCardlessEng">Twitter</a>, <a href="http://instagram.com/lifeatgocardless">Instagram</a> and <a href="http://linkedin.com/company/gocardless">LinkedIn</a>. </p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Software Engineer, Web Development – AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif; color: #662d91;">Teamwork makes the stream work.</h2> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Roku is changing how the world watches TV</strong></h3> <p>Roku is the #1 TV streaming platform in the U.S., Canada, and Mexico, and we've set our sights on powering every television in the world. Roku pioneered streaming to the TV. Our mission is to be the TV streaming platform that connects the entire TV ecosystem. We connect consumers to the content they love, enable content publishers to build and monetize large audiences, and provide advertisers unique capabilities to engage consumers.</p> <p>From your first day at Roku, you'll make a valuable - and valued - contribution. We're a fast-growing public company where no one is a bystander. We offer you the opportunity to delight millions of TV streamers around the world while gaining meaningful experience across a variety of disciplines.</p> <p> </p></div><p> </p> <h3>What does the team work on? </h3> <p>The Ads Customer Interfaces team develops full-stack web application services, APIs, and UIs that provide a unified approach to interfacing with internal and external customers across Roku's suite of advertising products. Our mission is to provide the best-in-class user experience and service while aiming to delight users of our products by making their jobs easier and allowing them to focus on their customers instead of getting bogged down by tedious business processes. In this role, you will work as a key member of the Ads Customer Interfaces team.</p> <p> </p> <h3>What is the role?</h3> <p>Roku pioneered streaming to the TV and continues to innovate and lead the industry. While we are well-positioned to help shape the future of television and streaming media worldwide, continued success stems from experienced software engineers like you developing core features for the Roku platform.</p> <p>Our new Senior Software Engineer will be contributing extensively to our container orchestrated platform, bringing together some of the latest web technologies with Ai expertise to develop a truly scalable and responsive web applications. To be successful you’ll need extensive experience of building reliable and scalable cloud-based solutions, a strong background in software engineering and an appetite to keep on top of modern software practices. This is a great role for a senior professional who enjoys a high level of visibility and thrives on great business impact.</p> <p>The features and performance improvements you implement directly impact millions of users every day. This is a great role for an experienced professional who has innovative ideas for complex problems and can translate these ideas into ultra-reliable software. </p> <p> </p> <h3>How will I use AI at Roku?</h3> <p> <br>At Roku, we don’t just use AI, we work with it. AI agents and smart tools help power drafts, analysis, and repetitive workflows, while our people bring direction, judgment, and accountability. We’re looking for curious, adaptable builders who can show how they’ve used AI or automation to move faster, raise the bar, and scale their impact.</p> <p> <br>We value your AI skills if have built fluency across the agentic engineering toolchain — coding harnesses like Claude Code or Cursor, MCP servers, custom skills, or agent frameworks. And you can describe projects where you shipped real work with these tools. You know how to drive an agent, verify its output, and ramp on an unfamiliar codebase with an agent helping you.</p> <p> </p> <h3>What are the responsiblities of the role? </h3> <ul> <li>Design, develop and deliver high-quality web applications and back-end services with modern frameworks and technologies.</li> <li>Work as a part of a high functioning team consisting of UX designers, software engineers, dev-ops, quality assurance and product management.</li> <li>Build and integrate AI-powered features into web applications and enterprise tools.</li> <li>Build and optimize Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions to power chatbot interactions</li> <li>Work both independently and paired with other team members to ensure efficient delivery of prioritised features.</li> <li>Take part in the planning and refinement of features along with the team to come up with innovative and collaborative designs.</li> <li>Develop new features and write test cases to ensure the quality of your code.</li> <li>Work with CI/CD tools to ensure that all software developed adheres to both quality and scaling requirements.</li> <li>Take a role in continuously improving our software delivery process, making it as efficient as possible, reducing wasteful activities and creating value.</li> <li>See a feature go all the way from design stage to being deployed into customer facing environments.</li> <li>Demonstrate the ability to dig deep to find solutions to challenging problems affecting our users.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h3>What experience would help someone be successful in this role at Roku? </h3> <ul> <li>Extensive expeirence  in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web frameworks (React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Express) on cloud-based technology, such as AWS and GCP.</li> <li>Experience of building large scale and low latency distributed systems.</li> <li>Solid understanding of algorithms, data structures, performance optimisation techniques, object-oriented programming.</li> <li>Experience using modern AI-assisted and agentic development workflows in day-to-day engineering using AI/ML APIs and SDKs</li> <li>Hands-on experience developing RAG solutions or working with LLMs for chatbots is preferred</li> <li>In-depth understanding of CI/CD and the tools used to implement them, such as Jenkins.</li> <li>Experience with software repository tools, such as GitLab and GitHub.</li> <li>Experience with productivity tools, such as Jira and Confluence.</li> <li>A good understanding of Agile practices.</li> <li>Ability to accurately estimate software tasks and work to schedule.</li> <li>Exposure to observability tools and practices (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana) are preferred.</li> <li>Understanding of databases and data architecture choices (SQL vs NoSQL, caching layers, and data access patterns)</li> <li>Track record of tuning performance and reliability for highly available services and web applications</li> <li>Familiarity with web security fundamentals and secure engineering practices</li> <li>Bachelors of Masters Degree in Compute Science/Software Engineering or related subject</li> </ul> <p> </p> <h6><span style="color: rgb(255, 255, 255);"><strong>#LI-PA1</strong></span></h6><div class="content-conclusion"><h3><strong><span style="font-family: GothamBold, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;">What's Roku's approach to hybrid working?</span></strong></h3> <p>Roku fosters an inclusive and collaborative environment where teams generally work in the office Monday through Thursday. Fridays are generally flexible for remote work, except for employees whose specific roles or assigned office location require five days' a week attendance.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What are some of the benefits?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is committed to offering a diverse range of benefits as part of our compensation package to support our employees and their families. Our comprehensive benefits include global access to mental health and financial wellness support and resources. Local benefits include statutory and voluntary benefits which may include healthcare (medical, dental, and vision), life, accident, disability, commuter, and retirement options (401(k)/pension). Employees are supported in taking time off, in accordance with local leave policies and other personal needs to support their evolving work and life needs. It's important to note that not every benefit is available in all locations or for every role. For details specific to your location, please consult with your recruiter.</p> <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>Accommodations</strong></h3> <p>Roku welcomes applicants of all backgrounds and provides reasonable accommodations and adjustments in accordance with applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodation at any point in the hiring process, please direct your inquiries to <a ---------- <p> </p> <h3 style="font-family: GothamBold,Helvetica,Arial,sans-serif;"><strong>What should I know about Roku's culture?</strong></h3> <p>Roku is a great place for people who want to work in a fast-paced environment where everyone is focused on the company's success rather than their own. We try to surround ourselves with people who are great at their jobs, who are easy to work with, and who keep their egos in check. We appreciate a sense of humor. We believe a fewer number of very talented folks can do more for less cost than a larger number of less talented teams. We're independent thinkers with big ideas who act boldly, move fast and accomplish extraordinary things through collaboration and trust. In short, at Roku you'll be part of a company that's changing how the world watches TV. </p> <p>We have a unique culture that we are proud of. We think of ourselves primarily as problem-solvers, which itself is a two-part idea. We come up with the solution, but the solution isn't real until it is built and delivered to the customer. That penchant for action gives us a pragmatic approach to innovation, one that has served us well since 2002. </p> <p>To learn more about Roku, our global footprint, and how we've grown, visit <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet">https://www.weareroku.com/factsheet</a>.</p> <p>By providing your information, you acknowledge that you want Roku to contact you about job roles, that you have read Roku's <a href="https://www.weareroku.com/roku-job-applicant-privacy-notice-for-job-applicants">Applicant Privacy Notice</a>, and understand that Roku will use your information as described in that notice. If you do not wish to receive any communications from Roku regarding this role or similar roles in the future, you may unsubscribe at any time by emailing <a ----- ----- Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Applied AI Engineer, Digital Natives
description: About the Team OpenAI’s Applied AI Engineering team helps organizations turn frontier AI capabilities into safe, reliable, and high-impact production systems. We work with customer executives, product and engineering teams, security leaders, and transformation teams to identify valuable opportunities, accelerate technical implementation, and scale what works. Enterprise deployments are defined by complexity rather than any one industry: existing architectures, diverse data environments, security and governance requirements, multiple stakeholder groups, and organization-wide change. We turn lessons from these deployments into better products and reusable patterns for customers everywhere. About the Role As an Applied AI Engineer, you will partner directly with Digital Native companies to design, build and deploy AI-powered products and systems. Working alongside customer product and engineering teams, you will take ideas from early experimentation through evaluation, production launch and scale, connecting technical decisions to user experience and measurable business impact. You will write and debug code, build evaluation systems, resolve complex integrations, and guide decisions involving model behavior, reliability, latency, cost, safety, security, governance, and operational readiness. Success is measured by production systems, sustained adoption, and meaningful customer impact—not simply activity or successful demonstrations. This is a rare opportunity to work on consequential real-world deployments at the frontier of AI while directly influencing how OpenAI’s products evolve. This role is based in London. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees In this role, you will: Partner directly with Digital Native customers to identify high-value opportunities and translate them into technical architectures, implementation plans, evaluation strategies, and measurable success criteria. Design, build, and deploy AI systems that solve important customer problems and produce measurable business outcomes. Work hands-on in code to build prototypes, evaluation harnesses, reference implementations, integrations, and production accelerators. Make sound technical decisions across models, agents, retrieval, tools, data, reliability, observability, latency, cost, safety, security, and governance. title: Senior Product Manager
description: About Userlane Userlane is a software adoption platform that shows enterprises whether their software and AI investments are actually working. Our team works with some of the biggest names in regulated industries, helping them get real value from technology and giving their employees the right support inside software applications they use every day. Based in Munich, growing internationally. Userlane combines Application Intelligence and Contextual Assistance for regulated industries. Application Intelligence shows where software creates cost and friction across the estate. Contextual Assistance helps people get work done in the moment, without training burden. We work with healthcare organizations across the US and Europe, helping clinical and operational teams work confidently in complex systems like EHRs and other core clinical and business applications. Your mission Own Application Intelligence at Userlane. You'll shape what we build across App Discovery, HEART Analytics and Portfolio Overview to help enterprise CIOs and IT leaders see where software spending delivers value and where it creates waste. You'll work on opportunities such as: Defining metrics that hold up : Own the methodology behind our HEART Analytics, deciding what each score measures, how it's calculated, and how it stays credible when data is incomplete. Delivering outcome-linked metrics : Connect usage data to business outcomes like cost savings, efficiency and compliance risk that enterprise executives can take action on Building for time-poor executives : Design analytics that bring insights to leaders and answers "what should I do?" not just "what happened?" Connecting fragmented data sources : Define the integration strategy to combine Userlane behavioural data with cost data from SAM tools, license data from IT asset management and employee data from HR systems, Transforming insights into action : Define what turns raw usage data into insights that drive action, not just dashboards people look at once AI adoption governance : Extend analytics to measure how AI assistants and agents affect productivity, cost and ROI. Your profile 5+ years of product management experience on data/analytics products within a modern product organisation You've defined a metrics methodology, scoring system or measurement framework that others build on, and you can defend the trade-offs behind it. You're comfortable reasoning about why one calculation approach produces misleading results in a specific scenario and another doesn't. You start with the business question, not the data. Your first instinct is "what decision are they trying to make?" rather than "what data do we have?" You hold your ground. You'll work with technically strong colleagues and leaders with well-formed opinions. You can disagree with them credibly, engage with their reasoning, and change your position when the evidence says so, not when the seniority does. You can hold a credible conversation with data engineers and data scientists about what the data can and cannot prove, and you understand the difference between interesting data and actionable insight You've worked in enterprise B2B (not B2C product analytics). Healthcare experience is a strong plus You figure out what works by talking to customers and watching them use the product You're capable of explaining things to engineers, salespeople, support agents and CEOs alike You're fluent in English (spoken and written) What's in for you Team & Culture : A high-performance culture with great leadership and a fun, engaged, motivated and diverse team with people from over 20 countries Impact: You'll be part of an empowered cross-functional team given the freedom and autonomy to solve real customer problems Product strategy influence : Work directly with our VP Product to shape our 2026-2030 strategy as we expand into new sectors Market : Userlane is among the global leaders in the rapidly growing Digital Adoption industry Growth : We take you and your development seriously. title: AI Engineer (Agentic)
description: <div class="content-intro"><div> <div> <div class="gmail_quote"> <div> <div><span id="m_-113912706363268805m_-2746164444908759431gmail-docs-internal-guid-131e4fb0-7fff-b4e9-ff50-e8cf32449b1b">CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025. Learn more at <a href="https://www.coreweave.com">www.coreweave.com</a>.</span></div> <div> </div> <div>We're proud to be a Living Wage accredited Employer.</div> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p> </p></div><p><strong>What You’ll Do:</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Physical AI Engineering Team</strong> at <strong>CoreWeave</strong> is responsible for building and scaling the core platform that powers the world’s most advanced engineering simulation and AI workflows. From evolving distributed architecture to enabling the next generation of agentic applications and physical AI, this team delivers the performant, reliable, and scalable foundation trusted by the world’s largest engineering companies.</p> <p><strong>About the role:</strong></p> <p>We're seeking a Senior AI Engineer to build the agentic layer of our Physical AI platform. You'll design, build and ship the agents behind our engineering copilot: systems that take a real engineering problem from an automotive, industrial or robotics team, explore the data, build and evaluate models, and return results an engineer can trust and act on.</p> <p>This is a hands-on engineering role, not a research role. You'll work alongside our researchers and software engineers: Research explores new approaches, and you turn the ones that work into reliable production systems. You'll own agents end to end – from tool and context design, through evaluation, to deployment and operation in production.</p> <h2>In this role, you will:</h2> <p><strong>Agentic Systems</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design and build agents that run the auto-research loop on customer engineering problems: data exploration, feature and model iteration, evaluation and reporting.</li> <li>Define tool interfaces and MCP servers that expose platform capabilities (data connectors, Physical AI libraries, experiment tracking and model registry, compute) to agents in a safe and predictable way.</li> <li>Own context and memory design for long-running agent tasks, including retrieval over engineering data, documentation and past experiments.</li> <li>Select and integrate models, balancing quality, latency and cost.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Evaluation & Reliability</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build evaluation harnesses and benchmarks that measure agent performance on real engineering use cases, so quality is measurable and regressions are visible.</li> <li>Instrument agents with tracing and observability and use that data to improve them.</li> <li>Design guardrails, sandboxed code execution, permission models and human-in-the-loop checkpoints so agents act safely on customer data and compute.</li> <li>Take agents from prototype to production: testing, CI/CD, deployment, monitoring and on-call ownership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>ML & Domain Work</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to ML work alongside the ML Engineers – model training, evaluation and Physical AI library development – especially where agents use or generate these components.</li> <li>Translate the vocabulary and workflows of physical engineering domains into agent behaviour, working with Forward Deployed Engineers and customers.</li> <li>Cover ML engineering work when needed, and help ML Engineers adopt agentic tooling in their own workflows.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Collaboration</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work with Research to turn promising agentic approaches into production systems.</li> <li>Partner with platform engineers on the agent runtime, workflow orchestration and auth as the platform moves to a distributed, agentic-ready architecture.</li> <li>Work with Frontend and Product to expose agent capabilities in the product in a way non-ML engineers trust.</li> <li>Mentor engineers, and interview and onboard new team members.</li> </ul> <h2>Who You Are:</h2> <ul> <li>5+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 2+ years building production systems on top of LLMs. Your background is in shipping and operating software, not academic research.</li> <li>You have shipped at least one agentic system to production with real users: tool-using agents, multi-step workflows or code-generating agents.</li> <li>Strong production Python.</li> <li>Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agent frameworks, and a clear view of where frameworks help and where they get in the way.</li> <li>Experience designing tools and APIs for agents, including MCP or equivalent tool-calling protocols.</li> <li>Experience building evaluation for LLM or agent systems: datasets, graders, LLM-as-judge, regression tracking.</li> <li>Solid ML fundamentals. You can train and evaluate a model with scikit-learn or PyTorch, and you understand validation, overfitting and uncertainty well enough to judge an agent's output.</li> <li>Experience with retrieval and context engineering for agents.</li> <li>Strong software engineering practices: code review, automated testing, CI/CD, observability, Docker and Kubernetes, and at least one major cloud (AWS preferred).</li> <li>Security-minded: sandboxing, authentication/authorisation, prompt injection and data isolation in multi-tenant systems.</li> <li>Clear technical communication with both engineers and non-ML stakeholders.</li> </ul> <h2>Preferred:</h2> <ul> <li>Experience with auto-research, data science agents or agents that write and run experiments (e.g. in notebooks).</li> <li>Experience with tabular, time-series, sensor, test or simulation data (automotive, aerospace, industrial or robotics).</li> <li>Previous experience as a backend or platform engineer before moving into AI engineering.</li> <li>Familiarity with experiment tracking tools and notebook environments.</li> <li>Experience serving open-source models on GPU infrastructure.</li> <li>Experience with workflow orchestration for long-running agent tasks.</li> <li>Experience with fine-tuning or reinforcement learning to improve agent behaviour.</li> </ul> <h2>Wondering if you're a good fit?</h2> <p>We believe in investing in our people, and value candidates who can bring their own diversified experiences to our teams – even if you aren't a 100% skill or experience match. Here are a few qualities we've found compatible with our team. If some of this describes you, we'd love to talk.</p> <ul> <li><strong>Builder:</strong> You ship agents people use, not demos.</li> <li><strong>Evaluation-first:</strong> You don't trust an agent you can't measure.</li> <li><strong>Production Pragmatism:</strong> You pick the simplest design that works, ship it, and know when an agent is the wrong answer.</li> <li><strong>Operational Rigor:</strong> You care about testing, deployments, and what happens after code ships – reliability, monitoring, and on-call health.</li> <li><strong>Curious about the domain:</strong> You want to understand how physical engineers work, not only how models work.</li> <li><strong>Ownership Mentality:</strong> You take full responsibility for outcomes and drive initiatives to completion.</li> <li><strong>Customer Obsession:</strong> You understand that our success is measured by our customers' success.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Why CoreWeave?</strong></p> <p>At CoreWeave, we work hard, have fun, and move fast!  We’re in an exciting stage of hyper-growth that you will not want to miss out on. We’re not afraid of a little chaos, and we’re constantly learning. Our team cares deeply about how we build our product and how we work together, which is represented through our core values: </p> <ul> <li>Be Curious at Your Core</li> <li>Act Like an Owner</li> <li>Empower Employees</li> <li>Deliver Best-in-Class Client Experiences</li> <li>Achieve More Together</li> </ul> <p>We support and encourage an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. We foster an environment that encourages collaboration and enables the development of innovative solutions to complex problems. As we get set for takeoff, the organization's growth opportunities are constantly expanding. You will be surrounded by some of the best talent in the industry, who will want to learn from you, too. Come join us! </p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em>To fulfill our obligation to protect client data, successful applicants offered employment with CoreWeave will be required to complete a basic criminal record check, conducted in compliance with GDPR. Employment offers are conditional upon receiving satisfactory check results.</em></p> <p><strong>What We Offer</strong></p> <p>In addition to a competitive salary, we offer a variety of benefits to support your needs, including:</p> <ul> <li>Family-level Medical Insurance</li> <li>Family-level Dental Insurance </li> <li>Generous Pension Contribution </li> <li>Life Assurance at 4x Salary </li> <li>Critical Illness Cover </li> <li>Employee Assistance Programme </li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement</li> <li>Work culture focused on innovative disruption</li> </ul> <p><em>Benefits may vary by location. </em></p> <p><strong>Equal Opportunity </strong></p> <p><em>CoreWeave is an equal opportunity employer, committed to fostering an inclusive and supportive workplace. title: Software Engineer - Build Platform
description: <p>At Optiver, the velocity of our software development is a critical part of our competitive advantage. Our ability to compete depends on how quickly new ideas can move from insight to production. The Developer Experience team is a strategic engineering function with a clear mandate: improve the development lifecycle across the company in ways that accelerate delivery and reduce our time to market. We build the tools, systems, and platforms that shape how software is developed at Optiver.</p> <p> </p> <p>The Build Platform sits at the heart of that lifecycle. Every change an engineer makes flows through it. When builds are fast, correct, and reproducible, engineers stay in flow, receive fast and trustworthy feedback, and shipping changes becomes routine. When builds are slow or unreliable, every team in the company pays the tax, one slow feedback loop at a time.</p> <p> </p> <p>We’re looking for a strong engineer with a passion for improving developer productivity, a deep interest in build systems, and the experience to design and operate platforms at scale. You’ll join a growing global Developer Experience team and help shape the future of how software is built, tested, and delivered at Optiver, enabling both engineers and agents to move from idea to production-ready software with greater speed and confidence.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>What you’ll do</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Shape the future of C++ builds at Optiver by designing and rolling out modern build systems that accelerate build times, improve reliability, and create a more consistent developer experience;</li> <li>Develop common build libraries, reusable CI/CD pipelines, and container images used across the company;</li> <li>Build observability into our platform so we can measure performance, reliability and adoption, and use that data to guide further improvements;</li> <li>Improve build performance at scale through incremental execution, caching, dependency analysis and efficient scheduling;</li> <li>Design workflows that enable agents to compile, test, diagnose failures, and validate changes reliably with minimal human intervention;</li> <li>Work closely with engineering teams to understand where existing workflows create friction and turn those problems into scalable solutions;</li> <li>Help teams adopt new tools and working practices, balancing standardisation with the needs of different codebases and engineering groups;</li> <li>Stay current with industry trends and emerging tools in the developer experience and build systems space, helping guide our adoption of best-in-class solutions.</li> </ul> <p> </p> <p>See the team lead's opinion on why DevEx matters <a href="https://optiver.com/working-at-optiver/career-hub/why-devex-matters/">here</a>.</p> <p> </p> <p><strong>Who you are</strong></p> <p><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>You are a strong software engineer with deep experience in C++ build systems and developer tooling;</li> <li>You have hands-on experience designing, adopting, or operating modern build systems such as Bazel, Buck2, Pants, or Gradle, ideally including migration from established tooling;</li> <li>You have a deep understanding of build system concepts including incremental builds, caching, reproducibility, dependency graphs, remote execution, and artifact management;</li> <li>You are skilled at diagnosing performance and reliability issues across the local development and continuous integration lifecycle, using data and observability to guide improvements;</li> <li>You have significant experience with CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, Buildkite, Jenkins, or similar, and understand how to design reliable, scalable pipelines and the infrastructure that supports them;</li> <li>You hold a deep understanding of the end-to-end lifecycle of software development from ideation to deployment;</li> <li>You have experience building tools and workflows around source control platforms such as GitHub and GitLab;</li> <li>You are passionate about developer title: Software Implementation Project Manager
description: About 3E: 3E is a mission-driven company dedicated to creating a safer and more sustainable world. We offer award-winning regulatory intelligence and AI solutions to help organizations protect people and products. With over 35 years of experience and a global presence, we empower our customers with innovative compliance solutions. You will get to work at a company that combines startup agility with the stability of an industry leader. Partner with enterprise customers and global experts to advance environmental safety and solve complex data science challenges. Join us and make an impact! About the Role As an Implementation Project Manager at 3E, you’ll lead larger, more complex customer implementations where successful delivery requires multiple products, technical contributors, workstreams, dependencies, and stakeholders to operate against one coordinated plan. You’ll be accountable for turning the customer’s scope of work into an executable implementation strategy and for determining whether the overall project succeeds—on time, within scope, adopted, and connected to a clear customer outcome. You’ll establish success and acceptance criteria, own the integrated project plan, manage risk and change, coordinate specialists and technical teams, and give both customers and 3E leadership a clear, data-backed view of project health. You’ll understand the technical delivery deeply enough to challenge assumptions, identify dependencies, connect customer needs with the right specialists, and engage credibly with Product and Engineering. You won’t need to personally execute every configuration, migration, or integration; your role is to ensure those pieces come together into a successful customer outcome. What You’ll Do Lead complex new-logo, cross-sell, and Value Realization implementations from internal handoff through customer acceptance and formal close. Translate complex scopes of work into an integrated delivery strategy covering products, workstreams, milestones, resources, dependencies, assumptions, exclusions, and acceptance criteria. Lead technical discovery and pre-integration planning with customers, CX technical specialists, and relevant internal teams. Own the master implementation plan and coordinate implementation specialists, Product, Engineering, Data, Cloud, technical consultants, external partners, and customer resources. Establish measurable success and acceptance criteria at kickoff and maintain accountability for those outcomes throughout delivery. Lead customer project governance, including senior stakeholder and sponsor communications. Maintain the milestone tracker and conduct phase-gate reviews, giving a clear assessment of whether projects are on track, at risk, or behind and establishing mitigation plans when required. Identify cross-workstream dependencies and risks early and determine their impact on the critical path. Lead complex, multi-product delivery by managing scope and change control, coordinating custom development through launch, maintaining a unified customer plan across teams, and providing leadership with clear, data-backed reporting on project health, risk, timelines, value, and adoption. Build and maintain dashboards or reporting tools that make project status and risks visible without relying solely on status meetings. Lead customer escalations diplomatically while maintaining accountability for customer commitments, decisions, resources, data readiness, and signoffs. Partner with Commercial on implementation handoff and identify expansion opportunities or renewal risks surfaced during delivery. Represent the delivery perspective during pre-sales scoping of complex or higher-risk opportunities so commitments can be successfully delivered. Drive structured post-onboarding Value Realization Projects, including complex migrations, integrations, optimization, remediation, and workflow initiatives. Manage multiple concurrent implementations and make prioritization decisions based on risk, complexity, dependencies, and customer impact. Identify opportunities to improve implementation processes, delivery predictability, time-to-value, and the overall customer experience. What Makes You a Great Fit Required 3–5 years of experience in software implementation, customer onboarding, technical account or project management, or professional services, ideally within B2B SaaS, technology, or information services. Demonstrated experience leading complex customer implementations with multiple workstreams, technical dependencies, contributors, or products. Experience owning project scope, plans, milestones, risks, dependencies, change control, customer communication, and delivery outcomes. Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand configuration, data, integration, and technical delivery sufficiently to coordinate specialists and identify risk; coding is not required. Demonstrated ability to lead customer conversations and communicate credibly with senior customer stakeholders. Ability to lead and influence cross-functional contributors without formal authority. Experience managing multiple concurrent projects and making informed prioritization decisions based on customer and business impact. Strong written and verbal communication, analytical thinking, judgment, and problem-solving skills. Proficiency with CRM tools such as Salesforce or HubSpot and Microsoft Office, with comfort using data, dashboards, and systems of record to communicate project health. Ability to navigate ambiguity and changing scope while maintaining accountability for outcomes. Willingness to travel 10–20%. Preferred Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems, environmental science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Experience with enterprise and/or mid-market SaaS customers. Experience developing or improving implementation processes and customer journeys. Familiarity with implementation, onboarding, or enablement tools such as Pendo, Gong, or Zendesk. Experience working with time-to-value, adoption, usage, or customer health metrics. Exposure to environmental, regulatory, compliance, chemical management, SDS, EHS, or sustainability software. Multilingual capability and/or experience supporting global customers. Disclosures: 3E is committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment. title: Staff Product Designer - Agentic Experiences
description: We design Spotify’s consumer experience end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints, from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify. Spotify's Core Experience (CoreX) team is shaping how listeners interact with Spotify through conversation, voice, and AI-powered experiences. We're building new ways for Premium subscribers to discover content, create playlists, control playback, and explore what they're listening to, using natural language. We're looking for a Staff Product Designer to help shape the future of these experiences. You'll lead the design direction for our conversational agent while staying close to the craft, designing and prototyping experiences that make AI feel useful, intuitive, and trustworthy. Working with product, engineering, machine learning, and design partners, you'll help create experiences that bring listeners closer to the audio and creators they love. What You'll Do Shape the experience strategy for Spotify's conversational agent, partnering with product, engineering, and data teams to create a shared design direction across multiple teams. Lead end-to-end product design for the core chat experience, from early exploration and prototyping through testing, refinement, and delivery. Define how conversational interactions work across Spotify, including when the agent responds, asks questions, offers choices, or helps listeners take action. Explore how conversation fits alongside familiar browsing and playback experiences across Home, Now Playing, and other key Spotify surfaces. Design intuitive voice and text interactions that support different listening contexts, including hands-free experiences, headphones, connected devices, and in-car listening. Create reusable interaction patterns and design guidance that help other teams bring conversational and AI-powered capabilities into their products. Partner with research, data science, and conversation design teams to evaluate experiences, understand listener behavior, and improve the product through evidence and experimentation. Build interactive prototypes to explore ideas, test assumptions, and make complex AI behaviors easier to understand and evaluate. Support and mentor designers across the program, share knowledge, and help teams make thoughtful design decisions that balance user needs, technical possibilities, and business goals. Who You Are You have experience leading product design for complex digital products, shaping design strategy, and bringing multiple teams together around a shared direction. You have worked on conversational, voice, or AI-powered experiences and understand how to design interactions that help people feel informed, confident, and in control. You bring strong interaction and visual design skills, with the ability to create consistent experiences across mobile, voice, and connected devices. You enjoy hands-on design and prototyping, using AI-enabled tools and emerging technologies to explore ideas, learn quickly, and communicate how an experience should work. You can turn complex or ambiguous challenges into clear design opportunities, using research, experimentation, and thoughtful judgment to guide decisions. You communicate ideas clearly, welcome different perspectives, and build collaborative relationships with designers, engineers, product partners, and senior stakeholders. You enjoy supporting other designers, sharing what you learn, and contributing to a team culture built on curiosity, creativity, and inclusion. Where You'll Be We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! For this role, you can be within the Europe region as long as we have a work location. This team operates within the BST and CET time zone for collaboration. Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can. description: <div>At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love.
